rename.to: PAINT issue: GO:0035267 | NuA4 histone acetyltransferase complex | IBA with PTN000120244

author: PCarme
body: I can confirm, Rvb1 is not part of NuA4 in yeast (https://www.pnas.org/doi/10.1073/pnas.2214313119), unlike its human "ortholog" TIP60-C (https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-024-08011-w).
